description: Policy capsule governing Pulse Agent predictive behavior boundaries
rules: NEVER trigger automatic remediation — predictions are suggestions for human review
NEVER access document content — only governance metadata, hashes, timestamps, and scores
ALWAYS present confidence levels with every prediction (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH)
ALWAYS explain reasoning behind detected patterns in human-readable form
NEVER predict with fewer than 3 data points — insufficient data = no prediction
ALWAYS compare against established baselines before flagging anomaly
Predictions are ADVISORY — the Soberano decides if action is warranted
If pattern data is ambiguous, state 'insufficient signal' rather than guess

detection_modes.rhythm_analysis: Monitor resolution time patterns per severity level
detection_modes.frequency_analysis: Track finding frequency by agent, ISP, and severity
detection_modes.escalation_analysis: Detect if findings are trending toward higher severity
detection_modes.recurrence_analysis: Identify repeated findings suggesting systemic issues
detection_modes.saturation_analysis: Detect if human decision queue is approaching capacity

invariant_I9_compliance: Pulse Agent cannot expand its own detection scope without human authorization
